cards.definition: Local area network: interconnected devices in a limited area such as one office.
cards.example: Every desk, printer, and camera on one floor sharing a switch.

zh-Hans.definition: 有限区域内互联的设备，例如一间办公室。

cards.definition: Wide area network: a network that spans a large geography, such as between cities.
cards.example: Two offices reaching each other through a provider or the internet.

zh-Hans.definition: 跨越较大地理范围的网络，例如城市之间。

cards.definition: Roles, not chassis types: a client uses a service; a server provides it. The same device can do both in different exchanges.
cards.example: A PC serves a file to a coworker, then acts as a client when it opens a website.

zh-Hans.definition: 角色而非机箱类型：客户端使用服务，服务器提供服务。同一设备在不同交换中可以兼任。

cards.definition: Forwards among devices inside one LAN. Typically many ports (24–48) for end hosts. Not the internet edge.
cards.example: Desks, cameras, and a file server all cabled to the same access switch.

zh-Hans.definition: 在同一局域网内转发；通常有很多端口供终端接入，不是互联网边缘。

cards.definition: Sits at the LAN edge and connects that LAN to other networks, such as the internet.
cards.example: A switch uplinks to a router; the router faces the WAN.

zh-Hans.definition: 放在局域网边缘，把该局域网接到其他网络，例如互联网。

cards.definition: An appliance that inspects traffic entering or leaving a network and allows or denies it by rule. Distinct from a host-based firewall on one PC.
cards.example: Two offices may reach each other while an attacker’s packets are dropped at the edge.

zh-Hans.definition: 检查进出整个网络的流量并按规则放行或拒绝；有别于单机上的主机防火墙。

cards.definition: A small multifunctional box that typically combines router, switch, wireless access point, and firewall. Fine at home; enterprises split the jobs.
cards.example: The Wi-Fi gateway under a TV is not “just a router.”

zh-Hans.definition: 小型多功能设备，通常兼路由、交换、无线接入和防火墙。家庭够用，企业会拆开这些角色。

cards.definition: A node that communicates over the network (client or server), as opposed to infrastructure that only forwards.
cards.example: A phone and a file server are end hosts; the switch between them is not.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过网络通信的节点（客户端或服务器），有别于只做转发的基础设施。

cards.definition: A family of standards for wired links: the physical media and how bits are grouped into messages. Not one cable.
cards.example: A Dell PC, a Cisco switch, and an ISP router can talk because they share 802.3 rules.

zh-Hans.definition: 有线链路的一族标准：物理介质，以及如何把比特组成报文。不是一根线。

cards.definition: A bit is a binary digit (0 or 1). A byte is eight bits. Links are rated in bits per second.
cards.example: 01001101 is one byte; a 100 Mbps link sends one hundred million bits each second.

zh-Hans.definition: 比特是二进制位（0 或 1）。字节是八个比特。链路速率按每秒比特计。

cards.definition: On a link, kilo/mega/giga/tera mean thousands: 1 Mb = 1,000,000 bits. The 1,024 names are kibibit, mebibit, and so on.
cards.example: Exam questions about Ethernet rate want 1,000, not 1,024.

zh-Hans.definition: 链路上的千/兆/吉/太是一千的幂：1 Mb = 1,000,000 比特。1,024 那套叫 kibibit、mebibit。

cards.definition: Unshielded twisted pair: eight copper wires in four pairs. The twist cuts pair EMI; there is no metallic shield.
cards.example: The common “Ethernet cable” from a PC to a floor switch.

zh-Hans.definition: 八根铜线拧成四对。对绞减轻线对间干扰；外面没有金属屏蔽。

cards.definition: Eight-position eight-contact plug and jack for UTP. RJ45 is the everyday name.
cards.example: The clip-in plug on a Cat 5e patch cord.

zh-Hans.definition: UTP 的八位八触点插头和插座。现场口中常叫 RJ45。

cards.definition: Copper Ethernet informal names. 10/100 use two pairs; gigabit and 10 Gb use four. All cap at 100 m.
cards.example: 1000BASE-T on Cat 5e across a floor; not across campus.

zh-Hans.definition: 铜缆以太网俗名。10/100 用两对，千兆和 10G 用四对。长度上限都是 100 米。

cards.definition: Straight-through joins pin n to pin n. Crossover swaps 1–2 with 3–6 (and 4–5 with 7–8 at gigabit) so like devices’ Tx meets Rx.
cards.example: PC to switch: straight. Two old routers: crossover.

zh-Hans.definition: 直通是同号对同号。交叉把 1–2 与 3–6 对调（千兆还对调 4–5 与 7–8），让同类设备的发送落到对端接收。

cards.definition: A port remaps its own Tx and Rx pairs to match the cable. Modern gear rarely cares which UTP pin-out you grabbed.
cards.example: Two current routers come up on a straight-through patch cord.

zh-Hans.definition: 端口自己对调发送/接收线对以匹配线缆。现代设备几乎不用再挑直通还是交叉。

cards.definition: Multimode: LED, wider core, hundreds of meters. Single-mode: laser, narrow core, tens of kilometers. Both beat copper’s 100 m.
cards.example: Riser between floors: MMF. Two buildings 8 km apart: SMF.

zh-Hans.definition: 多模：LED、较粗纤芯、数百米。单模：激光、极细纤芯、数十公里。都比铜缆的 100 米远。

cards.definition: Small form-factor pluggable transceiver that sits in an SFP port. Fiber Ethernet usually uses two strands: Tx to the far Rx.
cards.example: Cross the two strands and the link stays down, the same way Tx-to-Tx fails on copper.

zh-Hans.definition: 插在 SFP 口里的小型可插拔光模块。光纤以太网通常两芯：本端发送接到对端接收。

cards.definition: A shared set of rules for how devices exchange data. Two hosts on different protocol sets cannot converse.
cards.example: HTTPS, IPv4, and Ethernet are protocols at different layers.

zh-Hans.definition: 设备如何交换数据的一套共用规则。协议集不同的两台主机无法交谈。

cards.definition: Seven named layers (Physical through Application). Not what the internet runs; still the hallway numbers people say.
cards.example: “Layer 3 issue” almost always means IP, even on a TCP/IP network.

zh-Hans.definition: 七层（物理到应用）。互联网并不按它运行；人们口头编号仍用这套。

cards.definition: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Application. Application is still called Layer 7. The original RFC cut had four layers (Link at the bottom).
cards.example: Ethernet sits in L1+L2; IP in L3; TCP/UDP in L4; HTTPS in L7.

zh-Hans.definition: 物理、数据链路、网络、传输、应用。应用层仍叫第 7 层。最初 RFC 是四层（底下合称链路）。

cards.definition: Hop-to-hop delivery using MAC addresses. A hop is to the next router or the last host. Crossing a switch does not add a hop.
cards.example: PC1→R1→R2→SRV1 is three hops even if SW1 and SW2 are on the LANs.

zh-Hans.definition: 用 MAC 做逐跳转发。一跳到下一台路由器或最终主机。穿过交换机不算一跳。

cards.definition: IP delivers to the final host. Destination IP stays; destination MAC is rewritten at each hop.
cards.example: Every frame toward SRV1 still lists SRV1’s IP after R1 and R2 rebuild the L2 header.

zh-Hans.definition: IP 送到最终主机。目的 IP 不变；目的 MAC 每一跳重写。

cards.definition: A number that names an application process on a host (53 DNS, 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS). Not a physical jack.
cards.example: SRV1 shares one IP; port 443 is what steers the request into the web service.

zh-Hans.definition: 标明主机上某个应用进程的数字（53 DNS、80 HTTP、443 HTTPS）。不是交换机上的物理口。

cards.definition: L4PDU = data + L4 header (segment). L3PDU = segment + IP header (packet). L2PDU = packet + L2 header/trailer (frame). Payload is what a PDU carries.
cards.example: The frame on the wire carries a packet; that packet carries a segment.

zh-Hans.definition: L4PDU = 数据 + 传输头（段）。L3PDU = 段 + IP 头（包）。L2PDU = 包 + 链路头尾（帧）。载荷是 PDU 里面装着的东西。

cards.definition: Sender wraps down the stack: L7 data, L4 header (port), L3 header (IP), L2 header/trailer (MAC), then bits. Receiver unwraps in reverse.
cards.example: A header goes in front; Ethernet also adds a trailer used to catch errors.

zh-Hans.definition: 发送端自上而下包裹：应用数据、传输头（端口）、网络头（IP）、链路头尾（MAC），再变成比特。接收端反向解开。

cards.definition: Adjacent: a lower layer serves the layer above it on one host. Same-layer: this layer on host A talks to this layer on host B.
cards.example: L2 serving L3 on PC1 is adjacent. PC1’s L3 addressing SRV1’s L3 is same-layer.

zh-Hans.definition: 相邻层：同一主机上，下层为上层服务。同层：A 主机的这一层与 B 主机的同一层交谈。

cards.definition: Two shells. A GUI is windows and pointers. A CLI is typed lines. IOS on routers and switches is a CLI; the WLC GUI is later.
cards.example: Packet Tracer: click the icon, you are on the IOS CLI.

zh-Hans.definition: 两种外壳。GUI 是窗口和指针。CLI 是键入的行。路由器交换机上的 IOS 是 CLI；WLC 图形界面以后再讲。

cards.definition: The console port is local CLI only, not a data NIC. RJ45 console uses a rollover cable (1↔8, 2↔7, …). USB Mini-B is the other common console jack.
cards.example: Sit next to the rack. Telnet and SSH are the remote door, later.

zh-Hans.definition: 控制台口只给本地 CLI，不是业务网口。RJ45 控制台用翻转线（1↔8、2↔7…）。USB Mini-B 是另一种常见控制台口。

cards.definition: User EXEC (hostname>) looks a little. Privileged EXEC (hostname#) has full show, reload, and save. enable climbs; disable returns.
cards.example: show clock works at >. reload does not, until you enable.

zh-Hans.definition: 用户 EXEC（hostname>）只能看一点。特权 EXEC（hostname#）有完整 show、reload 和保存。enable 上去，disable 下来。

cards.definition: configure terminal from privileged EXEC. Prompt hostname(config)#. Edits running-config immediately. end / exit / Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Z return to #. do runs an EXEC command in place.
cards.example: hostname R1 changes the prompt at once. no hostname R1 restores Router.

zh-Hans.definition: 在特权 EXEC 里 configure terminal。提示符 hostname(config)#。立刻改 running-config。end / exit / Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Z 回到 #。do 可在配置模式跑 EXEC 命令。

cards.definition: running-config is RAM and live; lost on reload. startup-config is NVRAM and loaded at boot. write / write memory / copy run start copies RAM to NVRAM.
cards.example: Forget write, reload, and yesterday’s hostname is back — or factory-default if NVRAM was empty.

zh-Hans.definition: running-config 在 RAM，正在生效，reload 就丢。startup-config 在 NVRAM，开机装入。write / write memory / copy run start 把 RAM 抄到 NVRAM。

cards.definition: enable password is legacy cleartext (type 7 if you ask — weak). enable secret stores a hash (type 9 scrypt beats type 5 MD5). If both exist, only the secret works.
cards.example: enable secret lab, then show run | include enable.

zh-Hans.definition: enable password 是旧的明文（加上也只是弱的 type 7）。enable secret 存哈希（type 9 scrypt 优于 type 5 MD5）。两个都配时只认 secret。

cards.definition: Hosts that reach each other by switching, with no router in the middle. Two switches cabled together are one LAN; a router between them splits two.
cards.example: PC1 on SW1 talks to PC3 on SW2. The frames never take a Layer 3 hop.

zh-Hans.definition: 靠交换就能互访、中间没有路由器的一群主机。两台交换机直连是一个局域网；中间夹路由器就拆成两个。

cards.definition: Header: dest MAC, src MAC, Type/Length (14 bytes). Trailer: 4-byte FCS (CRC). Preamble + SFD ride along for Layer 1 clocking and are not part of the frame.
cards.example: ≤1500 in Type/Length is payload size. ≥1536 is EtherType; IPv4 is 0x0800.

zh-Hans.definition: 头：目的 MAC、源 MAC、Type/Length（14 字节）。尾：4 字节 FCS（CRC）。前导码和 SFD 只给一层对时钟，不算进帧。

cards.definition: A MAC is 6 bytes (48 bits), 12 hex characters, burned in by the vendor (BIA), globally unique. First 3 bytes are the IEEE OUI; the last 3 belong to the port.
cards.example: Cisco IOS prints 0cf5.a452.b101. Ports on one chassis are usually sequential.

zh-Hans.definition: MAC 是 6 字节（48 位），12 个十六进制字符，厂家烧录（BIA），全球唯一。前 3 字节是 IEEE 给的 OUI，后 3 字节标端口。

cards.definition: A switch reads the source MAC and binds it to the ingress port (dynamic CAM / MAC table). A quiet dynamic row ages out after 5 minutes.
cards.example: Frame from d8bb.c1cc.ff01 on G0/1 → later frames to that MAC leave G0/1.

zh-Hans.definition: 交换机看源 MAC，把它绑到入端口（动态 CAM / MAC 表）。五分钟听不到，这一行就老化删掉。

cards.definition: Known unicast: forward the table port. Unknown unicast or broadcast (ffff.ffff.ffff): flood every port except ingress. The switch does not rewrite the frame and is not a hop.
cards.example: Empty tables, PC1 to PC3 floods. The reply is a known unicast on a thin path.

zh-Hans.definition: 已知单播：只从表格里的端口转出。未知单播或广播（ffff.ffff.ffff）：除入口外全部泛洪。交换机不改写帧，也不算一跳。

cards.definition: Maps a known IP to an unknown MAC. Request is broadcast; reply is unicast. Both hosts keep an ARP table so the next packet skips the ask.
cards.example: PC1: who-has 192.168.1.3? PC3: ff03 is mine. Switches learn both MACs along the way.

zh-Hans.definition: 用已知 IP 问未知 MAC。请求是广播，应答是单播。两边都记 ARP 表，下一包不用再问。

cards.definition: Connectivity test: unicast ICMP echo request and echo reply. Cisco IOS sends five; ! is a reply, . is a timeout. Also prints min/avg/max RTT.
cards.example: ping 192.168.1.3 after ARP. Switching then sees ordinary known unicasts.

zh-Hans.definition: 连通性测试：单播 ICMP 回显请求和应答。IOS 发五次；! 是有应答，. 是超时。还打印最短/平均/最长往返时延。

cards.definition: 20–60 bytes. Version, IHL (header in 4-byte units), DSCP/ECN (QoS), Total Length (whole packet in bytes), fragmentation trio, TTL, Protocol, header checksum, two 32-bit addresses. Options are rare.
cards.example: TTL 64, Protocol 1 = ICMP, dest 192.168.2.2. Each router subtracts 1 from TTL; 0 drops the loop.

zh-Hans.definition: 20–60 字节。版本、IHL（首部以 4 字节计）、DSCP/ECN（QoS）、总长度（整包字节）、分片三字段、TTL、协议、首部校验和、两个 32 位地址。选项很少用。

cards.definition: 8 bits, weights 128…1, decimal 0–255. Binary→decimal: add the 1s. Decimal→binary: from 128 down, fit → 1 and subtract, else 0.

zh-Hans.definition: 8 位，权 128…1，十进制 0–255。二进制→十进制：把为 1 的权相加。十进制→二进制：从 128 往下，能减就写 1 并减，否则写 0。

cards.definition: 32-bit IPv4 written as four octets 0–255 joined by dots. Network bits on the left, host bits on the right. Neighbors share the prefix.

zh-Hans.definition: 32 位 IPv4 写成四个 0–255 的八位组，用点隔开。左边网络位，右边主机位。同一局域网共享前缀。

cards.definition: /X is how many leading bits are network. A netmask has 1s on those bits and 0s on host bits, always a run of 1s then 0s. IOS ip address wants the mask, not /X.

zh-Hans.definition: /X 是网络位的个数。掩码在这些位上为 1、主机位为 0，总是一串 1 再一串 0。IOS 的 ip address 要掩码，不要 /X。

cards.definition: Interface config: ip address A.B.C.D mask, then no shutdown. Router ports start administratively down. show ip interface brief for up/up; show ip interface for /prefix and MTU.
cards.example: int g0/0 → ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0 → no shutdown.

zh-Hans.definition: 接口配置：ip address A.B.C.D 掩码，然后 no shutdown。路由器接口默认管理关闭。show ip interface brief 看 up/up；show ip interface 看 /前缀 和 MTU。

cards.definition: Host bits all 0 = network (not a host). All 1 = directed broadcast. Usable hosts = 2^y − 2. First usable is network+1 (often the router); last is broadcast−1.
cards.example: 192.168.100.0/24 network, .255 broadcast, usable .1–.254 (254 hosts).

zh-Hans.definition: 主机位全 0 = 网络地址（不能给主机）。全 1 = 定向广播。可用主机 2^y − 2。第一个可用是网络+1（常给路由器）；最后一个是广播−1。

cards.definition: Class A 0–127 /8, B 128–191 /16, C 192–223 /24, D multicast, E experimental. Classful prefixes are obsolete; classless (any /X) is subnetting. 127.0.0.0/8 is loopback.
cards.example: 192.168.1.1 is class C. ping 127.0.0.1 never leaves the box.

cards.definition: The local router interface a host uses for dest IPs outside its prefix. The first frame’s dest MAC is the gateway, never the remote host. ARP learns that MAC.

zh-Hans.definition: 主机要把包发到自己前缀以外时，用的本网路由器接口。第一帧的目的 MAC 是网关，不是远端主机。用 ARP 学那个 MAC。

cards.definition: A switch MAC table maps MAC → port to forward or flood. A host or router ARP table maps IP → MAC to build the next Ethernet header. Switches do not rewrite frames.

zh-Hans.definition: 交换机 MAC 表是 MAC → 端口，用来转发或泛洪。主机或路由器 ARP 表是 IP → MAC，用来封装下一帧。交换机不改写帧。

cards.definition: After de-encapsulation, a router forwards using the matching route with the longest prefix. Connected, static, and local rows can all compete; only a match counts.

zh-Hans.definition: 拆掉以太网之后，路由器选前缀最长的那条匹配路由转发。直连、静态、本机路由都可以比，但必须先匹配。

cards.definition: Dest IP is constant end-to-end. Each hop builds a new frame whose dest MAC is the next hop (or the dest host on the last LAN). TTL drops by 1 at each router.

zh-Hans.definition: 目的 IP 端到端不变。每一跳封装新帧，目的 MAC 是下一跳（最后一网才是目的主机）。每台路由器把 TTL 减 1。

cards.definition: When the best match is a connected prefix, the next MAC is the dest host. The router ARPs that host. Intermediate hops ARP the next router instead.
cards.example: R3 C 192.168.3.0/24 → ARP 192.168.3.11 → frame to PC3. SW2 floods the request.

zh-Hans.definition: 最佳匹配是直连前缀时，下一个 MAC 就是目的主机。路由器对该主机做 ARP。中间跳则对下一台路由器做 ARP。

cards.definition: The reply uses the same gateway / longest-match / new-frame rules. If ARP caches and MAC tables already have the rows, there is no second request and no flood.
cards.example: PC3→PC1 after the ping: four frames, IPs swapped, known unicasts only.

zh-Hans.definition: 应答仍走网关 / 最长匹配 / 新帧。若 ARP 缓存和 MAC 表已有条目，就不再请求、不再泛洪。

cards.definition: Router interfaces start shutdown and need no shutdown (and usually an IPv4 address). Switch access ports start enabled — plug-and-play. Shutdown unused switch jacks.
cards.example: Cable R1 G0/1 to SW1 G0/1: only the switch side is up until you no shutdown the router.

zh-Hans.term: 路由器与交换机端口默认
zh-Hans.definition: 路由器接口默认 shutdown，需要 no shutdown（通常还要 IPv4）。交换机接入端口默认开启，即插即用。空闲交换机端口应 shutdown。

cards.definition: interface range paints many ports at once (f0/1-2). A comma mixes types (f0/3-8, g0/2). description is optional text; show interfaces description on any box, show interfaces status on switches only.
cards.example: int range f0/1-2 → description access PCs. Defaults like speed auto stay hidden in running-config.

zh-Hans.definition: interface range 一次配多口（f0/1-2）。逗号可混类型（f0/3-8, g0/2）。description 是可选说明；任何设备用 show interfaces description，交换机才有 show interfaces status。

cards.definition: Speed is Mbps (10/100 or 10/100/1000). Duplex: half = one direction at a time; full = both. speed {10|100|1000|auto}, duplex {auto|full|half}. a-100 / a-full means autoneg chose it.
cards.example: Gi0/1 speed 1000 duplex full prints as 1000 and full, not a-1000 a-full.

zh-Hans.definition: 速率是 Mbps（10/100 或 10/100/1000）。半双工一次只能一个方向；全双工可同时。speed {10|100|1000|auto}，duplex {auto|full|half}。a-100 / a-full 表示自动协商选中的。

cards.definition: Both auto: advertise and pick the best common mode (faster, then full). One side auto: sense speed or use your slowest; duplex is half at 10/100 and full at 1000+.
cards.example: Neighbor 100/full, you auto → you run 100/half. Duplex mismatch, still up/up.

zh-Hans.definition: 两端都 auto：通告并选双方最好的共同模式（先快后全双工）。只有一侧 auto：侦测速率或用最低速；10/100 用半双工，1000+ 用全双工。

cards.definition: A hub is one collision domain (shared media, half duplex). A switch port is its own (point-to-point, full duplex). CSMA/CD: listen, send, jam + random backoff. Late collision = after byte 64.
cards.example: Four PCs on a hub: one domain. Same four on a switch: four domains.

zh-Hans.definition: 集线器是一个冲突域（共享介质、半双工）。交换机每个端口自己一个（点到点、全双工）。CSMA/CD：先听再发，冲突则发送阻塞并随机退避。延迟冲突 = 第 64 字节之后。

cards.definition: Two ends hard-set to different Mbps. Both interfaces down/down. No traffic. Almost always a config typo.
cards.example: R1 speed 1000, SW1 speed 100 → show ip interface brief says down down on both.

zh-Hans.definition: 两端硬设成不同 Mbps。两边都是 down/down，不能通信。几乎都是配错。

cards.definition: One half, one full. Link stays up/up but crawls. Half-duplex side increments collisions / late collisions (false CSMA/CD). Full-duplex side often increments runts / CRC from the jam.
cards.example: Auto vs 100/full → auto becomes 100/half. Burst traffic; late collisions climb.

zh-Hans.definition: 一端半双工一端全双工。链路仍是 up/up 但很慢。半双工侧冲突/延迟冲突增加（误判 CSMA/CD）。全双工侧常因阻塞信号出现 runts / CRC。

cards.definition: Automatic network route to the prefix on an interface that has an IPv4 address and is up/up. Forward directly to the dest host (ARP that host).
cards.example: G0/0 192.168.1.1/24 → C 192.168.1.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0.

zh-Hans.definition: 接口有 IPv4 且 up/up 时自动安装的网络路由。把分组直接交给目的主机（对该主机做 ARP）。

cards.definition: Automatic host route to the interface’s own IPv4 address, always /32. Match means the packet is for this router — receive, do not forward.
cards.example: Same G0/0 also installs L 192.168.1.1/32. Dest .1 is received; dest .12 uses C.

zh-Hans.definition: 指向接口自身 IPv4 的自动主机路由，永远是 /32。匹配表示分组给本路由器——接收，不转发。

cards.definition: Network route: prefix shorter than /32 (many dest IPs). Host route: /32 (one dest IP). Connected is a network route; local is a host route.
cards.example: 192.168.1.0/24 is a network route. 192.168.1.1/32 is a host route.

zh-Hans.definition: 网络路由：前缀短于 /32（多个目的 IP）。主机路由：/32（一个目的 IP）。直连是网络路由；本机是主机路由。

cards.definition: ip route dest mask next-hop-IP. Table shows S via next-hop. A second lookup finds the exit interface. ARP only the next hop.

zh-Hans.definition: ip route 目的 掩码 下一跳 IP。表中显示 S via 下一跳。第二次查找才得到出接口。只对下一跳做 ARP。

cards.definition: ip route dest mask exit-interface. Table pretends the remote net is on that interface. The router ARPs the dest host and needs proxy ARP on the neighbor.
cards.example: ip route 192.168.3.0 255.255.255.0 g0/0 → R1 ARPs 192.168.3.11; R2 may reply with R2’s MAC.

zh-Hans.definition: ip route 目的 掩码 出接口。表里把远端网段当成接在该接口上。路由器对目的主机做 ARP，需要邻居的代理 ARP。

cards.definition: A router answers an ARP for someone else’s IP if it has a route to that dest, returning its own MAC. Needed for directly connected statics. On by default on Cisco; not guaranteed elsewhere.
cards.example: R1 ARPs 192.168.3.11 on the R1–R2 link; R2 replies with G0/0’s MAC because it can reach .3.0/24.

zh-Hans.definition: 路由器若有到达该目的的路由，就替别人应答 ARP，并填自己的 MAC。直连静态路由需要它。思科默认开启，其他厂商不一定。

cards.definition: ip route dest mask exit-interface next-hop. Table lists both via and the interface. No recursive lookup, no proxy ARP.

zh-Hans.definition: ip route 目的 掩码 出接口 下一跳。表里同时有 via 和接口。不必二次查找，也不靠代理 ARP。

cards.definition: Least-specific prefix: matches every IPv4 address. Used only when nothing longer matches. show ip route: Gateway of last resort. Typical internet dump. Printed S*.
cards.example: ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.2 — campus /24s still beat it.

zh-Hans.definition: 最不具体的前缀：匹配所有 IPv4。仅在没有更长匹配时使用。show ip route 显示 Gateway of last resort。常用来通向互联网。打印为 S*。

cards.definition: A router with no matching route (and no default) drops the packet. It never floods. With a default, leftovers go to the gateway of last resort instead.
cards.example: R1 has only C/L for 192.168.1.0/24 and 192.168.12.0/24; dest 192.168.3.11 is discarded.

zh-Hans.definition: 没有匹配路由（也没有默认路由）时，路由器丢弃分组，绝不泛洪。有默认路由时，剩余流量走向 Gateway of last resort。

cards.definition: Classless Inter-Domain Routing. Prefix length is not stuck at /8 /16 /24; the cut can sit mid-octet (/23, /26, /28). /X is CIDR notation. IOS still wants a subnet mask on ip address.
cards.example: 192.168.1.0/25 is legal. Classful rules would have forced a whole /24 or a /16.

zh-Hans.definition: 无类域间路由。前缀不必是 /8 /16 /24，可以切在八位组中间（/23、/26、/28）。/X 就是 CIDR 记法。IOS 配 ip address 仍要子网掩码。

cards.definition: Subnet by taking host bits into the prefix. 2^x equal subnets (FLSM). Original network bits stay fixed; flip only the borrowed bits. Each extra bit halves addresses per subnet.

zh-Hans.definition: 从主机位借入前缀来划分子网。FLSM 得到 2^x 个等大子网。原网络位不变，只翻转借入位。每多借 1 位，每子网地址数减半。

cards.definition: Network = host bits 0. Broadcast = host bits 1. First usable = net+1. Last usable = bcast−1. Hosts = 2^y−2. Borrowed bits count as network.

zh-Hans.definition: 网络地址 = 主机位全 0。广播 = 主机位全 1。第一可用 = 网络+1。最后可用 = 广播−1。主机数 = 2^y−2。借入位算网络位。

cards.definition: IOS dotted masks: /25=128, /26=192, /27=224, /28=240, /29=248, /30=252 (last octet). Same 128/192/224 pattern lives in the third octet for /17–/22.
/30 uses four addresses (net, two hosts, bcast). /31 uses two addresses and skips net/bcast (RFC 3021). /30 is still more common; IOS warns on /31 for non-P2P.
cards.example: R1–R2 serial: 203.0.113.0/31 on G0/0 of each, or 203.0.113.0/30 with .1 and .2 usable.

zh-Hans.definition: /30 用 4 个地址（网络、两主机、广播）。/31 只用 2 个，没有网络/广播（RFC 3021）。实验室仍更常见 /30；非点到点接口上 /31 会警告。

cards.definition: Variable-Length Subnet Masking: mix prefix lengths in one block. Sort needs largest first, tightest 2^y−2 that fits, next net = previous broadcast + 1. Exam: stay tight. Production: leave growth room.

zh-Hans.definition: 变长子网掩码：同一地址块混用不同前缀。按需求从大到小，选刚好 2^y−2 够用的前缀，下一个网络 = 上一广播+1。考试尽量紧；生产留余量。

cards.definition: A VLAN splits one physical switch into virtual switches. Flood (broadcast, unknown unicast) stays inside the VLAN. Subnets cut Layer 3; VLANs cut Layer 2. Exam: one subnet per VLAN.
cards.example: Engineering VLAN 10, HR 20, Sales 30 on SW1. An Engineering broadcast never hits HR ports.

zh-Hans.definition: VLAN 把一台物理交换机切成多台虚拟交换机。泛洪（广播、未知单播）不出本 VLAN。子网切三层，VLAN 切二层。考试按一 VLAN 一子网。

cards.definition: Access (untagged): one VLAN, usually a PC. Trunk (tagged): many VLANs, 802.1Q, usually a switch or ROAS router. Set switchport mode; do not leave DTP to guess.
cards.example: G0/1 mode access, access vlan 10. G0/0 encapsulation dot1q (if needed), mode trunk.

zh-Hans.definition: 接入（无标签）：一个 VLAN，通常接 PC。中继（带标签）：多个 VLAN，802.1Q，通常接交换机或单臂路由。要写 switchport mode，别让 DTP 猜。

cards.definition: 4-byte tag between Source and EtherType. TPID 0x8100, then PCP/DEI (QoS) and a 12-bit VID (4096 IDs). ISL is deprecated; dual-stack boxes need trunk encapsulation dot1q before mode trunk.
cards.example: PC1→PC10: access untagged, trunk tagged VID 10, access untagged again.

zh-Hans.definition: 插在源地址与 EtherType 之间的 4 字节标签。TPID 固定 0x8100，其后是 PCP/DEI（QoS）和 12 位 VID（4096 个 ID）。ISL 已弃用；同时支持两者的交换机要先 trunk encapsulation dot1q 再 mode trunk。

cards.definition: Default VLAN: access ports start in VLAN 1; cannot change. Native VLAN: untagged frames on a trunk join it, and native traffic leaves untagged. Native starts at 1, is per port, and must match both ends. Point it at an unused VLAN, not 1.
cards.example: mode trunk + native vlan 10 + access vlan 5 → untagged joins 10. Mismatch 10 vs 30 is VLAN hopping.

zh-Hans.definition: 默认 VLAN：接入口出厂在 VLAN 1，不能改。Native VLAN：中继上无标签帧归入它，该 VLAN 的帧也无标签发出。出厂是 1，按端口配，两端必须一致。指到未用 VLAN，不要用 1。

cards.definition: Default allow is 1–4094. WORD replaces the list. add / remove edit. all / none / except are the other forms. Forgetting add (allowed vlan 40 after 10,20,30) leaves only 40.
cards.example: allowed vlan 10,20,30 then add 1 → 1,10,20,30. Bare 40 → only 40.

zh-Hans.definition: 默认允许 1–4094。直接写 VLAN 号是替换列表。add / remove 才是增删。还有 all / none / except。忘了 add（10,20,30 之后写 allowed vlan 40）就只剩 40。

cards.term: ROAS vs SVI vs routed port
cards.definition: ROAS: trunk to a router; subifs use encapsulation dot1q N plus an IP (.N is only a name). SVI: interface vlan N on a multilayer switch after ip routing. Routed port: no switchport plus an IP for outside the LAN.
cards.example: G0/0.20 encapsulation dot1q 20, 172.16.1.65/26. Or interface vlan 20 with the same IP after ip routing.

zh-Hans.definition: ROAS：交换机到路由器一条中继；子接口 encapsulation dot1q N 再配 IP（.N 只是名字）。SVI：三层交换机 ip routing 后 interface vlan N。路由端口：no switchport 再配 IP，做出园区。

cards.definition: Admin mode is switchport mode. Operational is access or trunk after DTP. access never sends DTP and always operates access. trunk always operates trunk but still sends DTP. Default is dynamic auto.
cards.example: show interfaces g0/0 switchport: Administrative Mode: dynamic auto, Operational Mode: static access.

zh-Hans.term: DTP 管理模式与运行模式
zh-Hans.definition: 管理模式是 switchport mode 配的。运行模式是 DTP 谈完后的 access 或 trunk。access 不发 DTP，永远当接入。trunk 永远当中继，但仍发 DTP。默认 dynamic auto。
zh-Hans.example: show interfaces g0/0 switchport：Administrative Mode: dynamic auto，Operational Mode: static access。

cards.definition: auto + auto = access. desirable asks and trunks with auto, desirable, or trunk. access + anything dynamic stays access. access + trunk is invalid — do not use it.
cards.example: Two factory Cisco switches stay access. Change one end to dynamic desirable and they trunk.

zh-Hans.definition: auto + auto = 接入。desirable 会主动请求，和 auto、desirable、trunk 都能谈成中继。access 对任何动态模式仍是接入。access + trunk 是无效组合，不要用。
zh-Hans.example: 两台出厂思科交换机连上仍是接入。一端改成 dynamic desirable 就会变成中继。

cards.definition: Stops DTP on the port even if it is a trunk. Best practice: pin mode access or trunk, then nonegotiate. A host that speaks DTP can otherwise trunk a dynamic auto port and see every VLAN. Routers and non-Cisco switches never speak DTP — pin trunk yourself.
cards.example: interface g0/0 → switchport mode access → switchport nonegotiate. Negotiation of Trunking: Off.

zh-Hans.definition: 即使端口是中继也不发 DTP。习惯：先钉死 access 或 trunk，再 nonegotiate。会说 DTP 的主机否则能把 dynamic auto 谈成中继、看到所有 VLAN。路由器和非思科交换机不说 DTP，中继必须手配。
zh-Hans.example: interface g0/0 → switchport mode access → switchport nonegotiate。Negotiation of Trunking: Off。

cards.definition: VTP copies vlan.dat among Cisco switches in one domain, out trunks only. Revision starts at 0 and +1 per create/delete/rename. Sync only to a higher revision in the same domain. Blank name = domain NULL, no advertisements.
cards.example: vtp domain Manning then vlan 2, 3, 4 → Configuration Revision : 3, eight VLANs (1, 2–4, 1002–1005).

zh-Hans.definition: VTP 在同一域的思科交换机之间同步 vlan.dat，只从中继口发出。修订号从 0 起，每次创建/删除/改名 +1。只向更高修订号、同一域同步。域名为空就是 NULL，不发通告。
zh-Hans.example: vtp domain Manning 再 vlan 2, 3, 4 → Configuration Revision : 3，8 个 VLAN（1、2–4、1002–1005）。

cards.definition: Server (default) creates/edits and syncs. Client cannot vlan N but otherwise matches server. Transparent has its own DB, revision always 0, forwards VTP. Off neither syncs nor forwards. Cisco: leave modern boxes as servers.
cards.example: vtp mode client then vlan 5 → rejected. Transparent SW2 forwards SW1’s VTP to SW3 without adding VLAN 5 itself.

zh-Hans.definition: Server（默认）可改 VLAN 并同步。Client 不能 vlan N，其余像 server。Transparent 自己的库、修订号永远 0，但转发 VTP。Off 既不同步也不转发。现代交换机可以全留 server。
zh-Hans.example: vtp mode client 再 vlan 5 会被拒绝。Transparent 的 SW2 把 SW1 的 VTP 转给 SW3，自己不加 VLAN 5。

cards.term: VTP v3 primary and revision trap
cards.definition: v3: one primary server (vtp primary in privileged EXEC) may edit, including extended VLANs 1006–4094. v1/v2 a high-revision lab switch in the same domain overwrites the LAN. Reset rev to 0: bounce the domain name; or (v1/v2) transparent/off then back.
cards.example: Lab SW4 rev 50 joins Manning at rev 5 → v1/v2 production copies VLAN 99, 200 and drops 10/20/30. v3 ignores a non-primary.

zh-Hans.term: VTP v3 主服务器与修订号陷阱
zh-Hans.definition: v3：只有一台 primary server（特权模式 vtp primary）能改 VLAN，包括扩展 1006–4094。v1/v2 下同域高修订号的实验交换机能覆盖全网。把修订号清 0：改域名再改回来；或（仅 v1/v2）transparent/off 再改回。
zh-Hans.example: 实验 SW4 修订号 50 加入修订号 5 的 Manning → v1/v2 生产网抄成 VLAN 99、200，10/20/30 消失。v3 不会跟非 primary 同步。

cards.definition: Ethernet has no TTL. Redundant switch paths plus flooded broadcast, unknown unicast, or multicast circulate forever. Enough copies is a broadcast storm. The same source MAC appearing on two ports is MAC flapping.
cards.example: PC1 broadcasts on a three-switch ring. Copies circle both ways. SW1 rewrites PC1’s MAC between G0/0 and G0/1.

zh-Hans.term: 二层环路 / BUM 泛洪
zh-Hans.definition: 以太网没有 TTL。多余的交换机路径加上广播、未知单播、组播泛洪会永远转圈。帧够多就是广播风暴。同一源 MAC 在两个口上来回学，就是 MAC 抖动。

cards.definition: Elect the lowest BID as root. Each non-root switch picks one root port (best path to the root). Each segment picks one designated port; the other end is non-designated and blocks. BPDUs every 2 s; after convergence only the root originates them.
cards.example: show spanning-tree: Root ID, Bridge ID, then Role / Sts / Cost / Prio.Nbr. Root and designated forward; Altn/BLK is the spare.

zh-Hans.definition: BID 最低的当根桥。每台非根交换机选一个根端口（到根最好的路）。每条链路选一个指定端口，另一端非指定并阻塞。BPDU 每 2 秒；稳定后只有根桥起源。

cards.definition: 64-bit BID = 16-bit priority + 48-bit switch MAC. Priority is configurable value (default 32768) plus VLAN ID (Extended System ID). Set only multiples of 4096. priority 0 is the surest root. root primary is 24576 (will not set 0); root secondary is 28672.
cards.example: VLAN 1 default shows 32769. spanning-tree vlan 1 priority 24576 → 24577. priority 20000 is rejected.

zh-Hans.definition: 64 位 BID = 16 位优先级 + 48 位交换机 MAC。优先级是可配值（默认 32768）加上 VLAN ID。只能配 4096 的倍数。priority 0 最稳。root primary 是 24576（不会设成 0）；root secondary 是 28672。

cards.definition: Lowest root cost, then lowest neighbor BID, then lowest neighbor port ID (their Prio.Nbr). Root advertises 0; add the receiving port’s cost: 10 Mbps=100, 100 Mbps=19, 1 Gbps=4, 10 Gbps=2. Do not use the local port name.
cards.example: Two equal-cost links to the root: SW1 G0/1 wins because it faces SW3 G0/0 (128.1), not because G0/1 is a nicer local name.

zh-Hans.definition: 先最低根开销，再最低邻居 BID，再最低邻居端口 ID（对面的 Prio.Nbr）。根通告 0；加上收 BPDU 那一口的开销：10M=100，100M=19，1G=4，10G=2。不要用本地口名。

cards.definition: BLK no data; LIS BPDUs only; LRN learns MACs; FWD sends data. Hello 2 s, forward delay 15+15, max age 20. New port 30 s; silent fail up to 50 s. PortFast skips to FWD on host ports; BPDU Guard err-disables if a BPDU arrives.
cards.example: spanning-tree portfast and bpduguard enable on G1/0. Extra switch → err-disable. Unplug, shutdown / no shutdown.

zh-Hans.definition: BLK 不转发；LIS 只跑 BPDU；LRN 学 MAC；FWD 才转发。Hello 2 秒，转发延迟 15+15，max age 20。新口 30 秒；静默故障最多 50 秒。PortFast 让主机口直接 FWD；BPDU Guard 收到 BPDU 就 err-disable。

cards.definition: Cisco runs PVST+ or Rapid PVST+, not bare 802.1D/w. show spanning-tree: protocol ieee = PVST+; rstp = Rapid PVST+. mode pvst | rapid-pvst. MSTP (802.1s) groups VLANs into instances and uses RSTP speed.
cards.example: spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst → Spanning tree enabled protocol rstp.

zh-Hans.definition: 思科跑 PVST+ 或 Rapid PVST+，不是裸的 802.1D/w。show spanning-tree：protocol ieee = PVST+；rstp = Rapid PVST+。mode pvst 或 rapid-pvst。MSTP（802.1s）把多个 VLAN 合成实例，仍用 RSTP 的速度。

cards.definition: Discarding = STP blocking + listening (CLI still says BLK). Then learning, forwarding. Same algorithm. Leftover ports: alternate (spare toward the root; DP on another switch) or backup (second port on a hub to your own DP). All designated ports send BPDUs every 2 s.
cards.example: Hub: SW3 G0/0 Desg FWD, G0/1 Back BLK. SW1 G0/0 Root FWD, G0/1 Altn BLK. Lowest local port ID wins on that segment.

zh-Hans.definition: Discarding = STP 的 blocking + listening（命令行仍写 BLK）。然后 learning、forwarding。算法相同。剩下的口：alternate（通向根的备用，对面是别的交换机的 DP）或 backup（集线器上通向自己 DP 的第二口）。所有指定口每 2 秒自己发 BPDU。

cards.term: RSTP link types and 6 s wait
cards.definition: P2p = full duplex (sync). Shared = half (no sync, 30 s). Edge = PortFast, not link-type. Three missed hellos = 6 s, then sync; down/down skips that. Edge up/down is not a topology change. Long costs: 10 Gbps = 2,000 (×10 speed → ÷10 cost).
cards.example: show spanning-tree Type: P2p, Shr, P2p Edge. pathcost method short is still default on many Rapid boxes.

zh-Hans.term: RSTP 链路类型与 6 秒等待
zh-Hans.definition: P2p = 全双工（可同步）。Shared = 半双工（不同步，30 秒）。Edge = PortFast，不是 link-type。漏 3 个 hello = 6 秒再同步；口 down/down 就跳过。Edge 起落不算拓扑变化。长开销：10 Gbps = 2000（速度 ×10，开销 ÷10）。

cards.term: Root Guard, Loop Guard, BPDU Filter
cards.definition: Root Guard: superior BPDU → root-inconsistent (BKN *ROOT_Inc). Loop Guard: BPDUs stop → loop-inconsistent. They cannot share a port. Interface BPDU Filter = STP off (no send, ignore receive). Global portfast bpdufilter default: stop sending; a received BPDU turns PortFast and Filter off.
cards.example: spanning-tree guard root on the customer-facing port. Prefer BPDU Guard on PCs, not Filter.

zh-Hans.definition: Root Guard：更好的 BPDU → root-inconsistent。Loop Guard：BPDU 停了 → loop-inconsistent。不能用在同一口。接口上的 BPDU Filter = 关掉 STP（不发、不理）。全局 portfast bpdufilter default：只停发；收到 BPDU 就关掉 PortFast 和 Filter。

cards.definition: Without a bundle, STP/RSTP forwards on one cable and discards the rest. EtherChannel (port-channel) is one logical port: all members forward; BUM that entered the bundle does not leave sibling members. Some Po links in a larger LAN still sit Altn BLK.
cards.example: show spanning-tree lists Po1, not Gi0/0. Combined bandwidth can drop the STP cost (two 1G members often cost 3).

zh-Hans.term: 以太通道 vs STP 多余链路
zh-Hans.definition: 不绑的话，STP/RSTP 只让一条线转发，其余丢弃。EtherChannel（port-channel）是一个逻辑口：成员都能转；从捆绑进来的 BUM 不会从同组其它成员出去。更大的局域网里，有的 Po 仍会 Altn BLK。

cards.definition: PAgP (Cisco, 8 links): desirable / auto. LACP (802.3ad, any vendor; 16 members / 8 active): active / passive. Static: on + on only. Two listeners or mixed languages do not form. Group number is local.
cards.example: Non-Cisco neighbor → LACP. show lacp neighbor partner Passive + channel up → you are active. channel-group 1 mode active.

zh-Hans.definition: PAgP（思科，8 条）：desirable / auto。LACP（802.3ad，任意厂商；16 成员 / 8 活动）：active / passive。静态：只能 on + on。两个只听的，或两种协议，都组不成。组号只在本机有意义。

cards.definition: SU = Layer 2 in use. RU = Layer 3 in use. Member P = bundled, I = stand-alone, s = suspended (mismatch). S ≠ s. Speed, duplex, access/trunk, VLANs must match. Live edits go on the port-channel.
cards.example: Native VLAN change on one member → Gi0/0(s). no switchport trunk native vlan 10 puts it back.

zh-Hans.definition: SU = 二层在用。RU = 三层在用。成员 P = 已捆绑，I = 独立，s = 挂起（不匹配）。S 不是 s。速率、双工、接入/中继、VLAN 必须一致。上线后改 Po，别改成员。

cards.definition: Hash by flow (often src-dst-ip). Four 1G members = 4G bandwidth; one flow stays 1G. L3: no switchport on members, IP on the port-channel, same mode rules. show etherchannel load-balance / PoN(RU).
cards.example: port-channel load-balance src-dst-ip. dst-mac alone can pin gateway traffic on one member.

zh-Hans.definition: 按流哈希（常见 src-dst-ip）。四条 1G = 4G 带宽；一条流仍是 1G。三层：成员先 no switchport，地址写在 port-channel，模式规则相同。show etherchannel load-balance / PoN(RU)。

cards.term: IGP vs EGP, DV vs LS
cards.definition: IGP exchanges prefixes inside one AS; EGP between ASes. Distance-vector (RIP, EIGRP) is rumor — metric and next hop only. Link-state (OSPF, IS-IS) floods a map (LSDB). BGP is the path-vector EGP (AS list, not router list).
cards.example: D = EIGRP (DUAL). O = OSPF. R = RIP. B = BGP. IS-IS is a provider IGP, not an exam protocol.

zh-Hans.term: IGP 与 EGP，距离矢量与链路状态
zh-Hans.definition: IGP 在一个自治系统内交换前缀；EGP 在自治系统之间。距离矢量（RIP、EIGRP）是传闻——只有度量和下一跳。链路状态（OSPF、IS-IS）洪泛一张图（LSDB）。BGP 是路径矢量 EGP（AS 列表，不是路由器列表）。

cards.definition: Same dest + same protocol → lowest metric; equal metrics → ECMP (max 4). Same dest + different protocols → lowest AD. Different prefix lengths are different dests and all install. Forwarding uses only the most specific matching route.
cards.example: O [110/2] beats O [110/4]. D [90/3584] beats O [110/4]. S /24 and O /27 both sit in the table.

zh-Hans.definition: 同一目的、同一协议 → 度量小者胜；度量相同 → ECMP（默认最多 4 条）。同一目的、不同协议 → AD 小者胜。前缀长度不同就是不同目的，都会进表。转发只看最具体的匹配路由。

cards.definition: Connected 0, static 1, eBGP 20, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, IS-IS 115, RIP 120, iBGP 200, unusable 255. Lower is more trusted. 255 does not install.
cards.example: show ip route prints [AD/metric]. D 10.0.0.0 [90/3584] via 192.168.12.2.

zh-Hans.definition: 直连 0，静态 1，eBGP 20，EIGRP 90，OSPF 110，IS-IS 115，RIP 120，iBGP 200，不可用 255。越小越可信。255 不会进表。

cards.definition: A static with AD higher than the primary protocol so it stays out of the table until that path dies. ip route dest mask next-hop 111 behind OSPF (110). Same AD still prefers static. Static metric is always 0.

zh-Hans.definition: 把静态路由的 AD 调得比主用协议高，主用活着时它不进表。OSPF 后面写 ip route dest mask next-hop 111。AD 相同仍偏向静态。静态度量永远是 0。

cards.definition: router ospf pid then network ip wildcard area 0. 0 bits must match an interface IP. Activates those ifaces and advertises each iface prefix — not the wildcard range. Prefer host + 0.0.0.0. Wildcard octet = 255 − mask octet.

zh-Hans.term: OSPF network 命令 / 通配符
zh-Hans.definition: router ospf pid 再 network ip wildcard area 0。通配符里 0 位必须和接口 IP 一致。激活这些接口并通告各自前缀——不是通配符范围。习惯用主机地址 + 0.0.0.0。通配符每段 = 255 − 掩码。

cards.definition: OSPFv2 is open + Dijkstra. One LSDB per area, filled by LSA flooding. Area 0 is the backbone. ABR connects a spoke to 0 (one LSDB per area). ASBR injects external. Intra / inter / external routes.
cards.example: R1 in area 0 facing the internet is internal + backbone + ASBR. O*E2 0.0.0.0/0 is external.

zh-Hans.definition: OSPFv2 = 开放 + Dijkstra。每个区域一份 LSDB，靠 LSA 泛洪。区域 0 是骨干。ABR 把分支接到 0（每个区域一份库）。ASBR 注入外部。区内 / 区间 / 外部路由。

cards.definition: Cost = ref / bw, floor 1. Default ref 100 Mbps so 1G costs 1. auto-cost reference-bandwidth must match everywhere. RID: unique; router-id, else highest loopback, else highest physical. A late loopback does not steal it.
cards.example: router-id 172.16.1.1 then clear ip ospf process if neighbors exist. ip ospf cost 5 on one iface.

zh-Hans.term: OSPF 开销与路由器 ID
zh-Hans.definition: 开销 = 参考带宽 / 接口带宽，小于 1 记 1。默认参考 100 Mbps，所以 1G 也是 1。auto-cost reference-bandwidth 全网要一致。RID 必须唯一：先 router-id，否则最高环回，再否则最高物理口。后加的环回不会抢走。

cards.definition: network ip wildcard area 0 or ip ospf 1 area 0. Passive: advertise the prefix, no hello. default-information originate after a local default; the box becomes ASBR (O*E2).
cards.example: passive-interface g0/2 and l0. ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 next-hop then originate.

zh-Hans.definition: network ip wildcard area 0 或 ip ospf 1 area 0。被动：仍通告前缀，不发 hello。本地先有默认路由再 default-information originate，本机变成 ASBR（O*E2）。

cards.definition: 2-Way = neighbor. Full = adjacent. Hello 10 / dead 40 to 224.0.0.5 (.6 = DR/BDR). Broadcast elects DR/BDR (priority, then RID); no preempt; BDR promotes. Point-to-point = FULL/-. Type 1 / 2 / 5. Network-type mismatch: Full, no map. MTU: stuck ExStart.
cards.example: show ip ospf neighbor. ip ospf network point-to-point on both Ethernet ends.

zh-Hans.definition: 2-Way = 邻居。Full = 邻接。Hello 10 / dead 40，发到 224.0.0.5（.6 = DR/BDR）。广播选 DR/BDR（优先级再 RID）；不抢占；BDR 顶上。点到点 = FULL/-。类型 1 / 2 / 5。网络类型不一致：Full 但不同步。MTU：卡在 ExStart。

cards.definition: A group shares a VIP (host default gateway) and a virtual MAC. The active answers ARP with the vMAC. Failover: standby becomes active and sends GARP (src = vMAC, dst broadcast) so switches re-learn. Hosts do not change ARP or the gateway IP.
cards.example: VIP 10.0.0.1. R1 .2 active, R2 .3 standby. After R1 dies, R2 GARPs; PCs still send to the same vMAC.

zh-Hans.term: FHRP 虚拟 IP 与故障切换
zh-Hans.definition: 一组路由器共享 VIP（主机默认网关）和虚拟 MAC。活跃路由器用虚拟 MAC 回答 ARP。故障切换：备用变活跃，发免费 ARP（源=虚拟 MAC，目的=广播）让交换机重学。主机不改 ARP 和网关。

cards.definition: HSRP: Cisco, active/standby, preempt off, per-subnet LB. VRRP: standard, master/backup, preempt on, per-subnet. GLBP: Cisco, AVG/AVF, per-host (round-robin vMACs). Multicast: HSRPv1 224.0.0.2, v2/GLBP 224.0.0.102, VRRP 224.0.0.18.
cards.example: Juniper peer → VRRP. Split one subnet → GLBP. Cisco-only pair → HSRP.

zh-Hans.definition: HSRP：思科，活跃/备用，默认不抢占，按子网负载分担。VRRP：标准，主/备，默认抢占，按子网。GLBP：思科，AVG/AVF，按主机（轮询虚拟 MAC）。组播：HSRPv1 用 224.0.0.2，v2 与 GLBP 用 .102，VRRP 用 .18。

cards.term: HSRPv1 vs v2 and virtual MAC
cards.definition: v1: 224.0.0.2, vMAC 0000.0c07.acXX, groups 0–255, IPv4 only. v2: 224.0.0.102, 0000.0c9f.fXXX, groups 0–4095, IPv6. Versions do not interoperate. Group 15 v1 = 0000.0c07.ac0f. VRRP vMAC 0000.5e00.01XX. GLBP 0007.b400.XXYY.
cards.example: HSRPv2 group 1 → 0000.0c9f.f001. GLBP group 1 AVF 1 → 0007.b400.0101.

cards.definition: standby version 2; standby 1 ip VIP (group and VIP must match). Priority default 100, then highest interface IP. standby 1 preempt (off by default). Real IP stays on ip address. show standby brief: Active local, P = preempt. Hello 3 / hold 10.
cards.example: R1 .2 priority 105 preempt; R2 .3 default 100. VIP 10.0.0.1.

zh-Hans.definition: standby version 2；standby 1 ip VIP（组号和 VIP 必须一致）。优先级默认 100，再比接口 IP。standby 1 preempt（默认关）。真实地址仍用 ip address。show standby brief：Active local，P = 抢占。Hello 3 / hold 10。

cards.definition: IPv4 32 bits (~4.3 billion) exhausted. IPv6 is 128 bits (2^128). Each extra bit doubles. Version 5 was ST. One hex digit = 4 bits (nibble). Eight hextets, usually /64.
cards.example: 1101 1011 0010 1111 → db2f. Documentation range 2001:db8::/32.

zh-Hans.definition: IPv4 32 位（约 43 亿）耗尽。IPv6 是 128 位（2^128）。多 1 位数量翻倍。版本 5 是 ST。一位十六进制 = 4 比特（半字节）。八个 hextet，通常 /64。

cards.definition: Drop leading zeros. One :: for the longest all-zero run (tie → leftmost). Never two ::. Never :: a single 0. Lowercase. /64 prefix = zero the last four hextets.

zh-Hans.definition: 去掉前导 0。一段连续全 0 hextet 用一次 ::（最长优先，并列取最左）。不能两个 ::。单个 0 不能用 ::。小写。/64 前缀 = 后四个 hextet 置 0。

cards.definition: ipv6 unicast-routing first (forwarding off by default). ipv6 address addr/64. Extra addresses add; no to remove. ipv6 enable = LLA only. EUI-64: split MAC, insert fffe, invert bit 7.

zh-Hans.definition: 先 ipv6 unicast-routing（默认不转发）。ipv6 address 地址/64。再配是追加，要用 no 删。ipv6 enable 只有链路本地。EUI-64：MAC 对半、插入 fffe、翻转第 7 位。

cards.definition: GUA public (was 2000::/3). ULA fd00::/8 (fc reserved). LLA fe80::/64 required, on-link, one per iface. Multicast ff + scope (ff02 link). All-nodes ff02::1 (no broadcast). Anycast = same unicast, closest. :: unspecified, ::1 loopback.
cards.example: ff02::2 all-routers. show ipv6 interface lists joined groups.

zh-Hans.definition: 全球单播（原 2000::/3）。唯一本地 fd00::/8（fc 保留）。链路本地 fe80::/64，每口必须一个，只在本链路。组播 ff + 范围（ff02 链路）。全节点 ff02::1（无广播）。任播 = 同一单播选最近。:: 未指定，::1 回环。

cards.definition: No ARP. Solicited-node = ff02::1:ff + last six hex. NS 135 to that group, unicast NA 136. RS 133 to ff02::2, RA 134 to ff02::1. SLAAC: autoconfig (add default for ::/0 via RA LLA). DAD: NS to self; NA → DUP.
cards.example: 2001:db8:123::1 → ff02::1:ff00:1. show ipv6 neighbors (REACH).

zh-Hans.definition: 不用 ARP。被请求节点 = ff02::1:ff + 后六位十六进制。NS 135 发到该组，单播 NA 136。RS 133 到 ff02::2，RA 134 到 ff02::1。SLAAC：autoconfig（加 default 会装 ::/0，下一跳是 RA 的 LLA）。DAD：向自己发 NS；有 NA 就是 DUP。

cards.definition: C = connected /64 (network route ≤ /127). L = local /128 (host route, receive). No C/L for LLAs. FF00::/8 via Null0 (do not forward multicast). Longest prefix wins. Need ipv6 unicast-routing.
cards.example: Dest 2001:db8:1::1 hits L /128 over C /64.

zh-Hans.definition: C = 直连 /64（网络路由 ≤ /127）。L = 本地 /128（主机路由，本机接收）。LLA 没有 C/L。FF00::/8 走 Null0（不转发组播）。最长匹配。需要 ipv6 unicast-routing。

cards.definition: ipv6 route prefix next-hop (recursive) or iface+next-hop (fully specified). Exit-only on Ethernet shows but INCMP — no proxy NDP. LLA next hop must include iface. Same LLA on two ifaces is legal.
cards.example: ipv6 route 2001:db8:3::/64 g0/0 2001:db8:12::2. ipv6 route … fe80::1 is rejected.

zh-Hans.definition: ipv6 route 前缀 下一跳（递归）或 接口+下一跳（完全指定）。以太网上只写出接口：表里有，邻居 INCMP——没有代理 NDP。LLA 下一跳必须带接口。同一路由器两口可以用相同 LLA。

cards.definition: Default is ::/0 (like 0.0.0.0/0). Static AD default 1. Trailing AD 2 floats a backup; it enters only after the better row is gone. autoconfig default also installs ::/0 via the RA LLA.
cards.example: ipv6 route ::/0 2001:db8::2 and ipv6 route ::/0 2001:db8:1::2 2.

zh-Hans.definition: 默认是 ::/0（类似 0.0.0.0/0）。静态 AD 默认 1。末尾写 2 做浮动备份，更好的条目消失才进表。autoconfig default 也会装 ::/0，下一跳是 RA 的 LLA。
